note: Transcribed from the 5P:T rulebook, the Field Commander's Guide and 5PFH 3rd edition. Keyed = taken from a book; mark each Verified after checking.

rows.title: Reinforcements
rows.text: One side receives reinforcements: significant manpower or a new capability (armor, specialists). Player: add a unit to your force, or an extra enemy unit next mission. Operational: one army +1 Army Strength.

rows.title: Critical Strike
rows.text: One side attacks an important or high-priority target. Player: play out the mission. Operational: if it succeeds, an army at 4+ Army Strength loses 1.

rows.title: New Main Character
rows.text: The focal character of your force changes. Player: choose or create a new main character.

rows.title: Flashback
rows.text: Play out an event from the past of a character, unit, or the conflict.

rows.title: Balance is Shifting
rows.text: One side is gaining the upper hand. Operational: in one Zone, +1 Army Strength and the enemy army −1.

rows.title: Shortfall
rows.text: One side runs short of a resource such as fuel or ammunition. Operational: one army with 4+ Army Strength loses 1.

rows.title: New Character
rows.text: A new character joins the story. Player: add a new character to your force.

rows.title: New Ally
rows.text: One side gains a new ally. Player: a new force, an off-world operation, or an unusual unit. Operational: add a new Zone, the ally at Army Strength 4 against 2.

rows.title: Loss of Initiative
rows.text: The side on the defensive seizes the initiative. Operational: the side with the lowest Cohesion adds +1 Army Strength and fights in that Zone.

rows.title: Change of Perspective *
rows.text: The campaign shifts to a new point of view. Player: choose a side or faction you now play as. (Dramatic: reroll if it does not fit.)

rows.title: Unconventional Operation
rows.text: One side launches a special operations mission. Player: play it out. Operational: pick an enemy army and roll 1D6; below its Army Strength, it loses 1.

rows.title: Loss of Capability
rows.text: One side loses a capability (artillery, air movement…). Player: cannot use it next turn. Operational: that side carries out no Order this turn.

rows.title: Side Story *
rows.text: A secondary story unfolds alongside the conflict. Play it through. (Dramatic: reroll if it does not fit.)

rows.title: Unit Reassignment
rows.text: A unit is reassigned elsewhere. Player: one unit leaves and is replaced with a new unit.

rows.title: Change in Strategy
rows.text: One side adopts a new strategy. Player: reflect it in the next scenario. Operational: that side carries out two Orders this turn.

rows.title: Change of Focus
rows.text: The fighting shifts to a new area. Player: choose a new area (and force) to play. Operational: change the Operational Focus.

rows.title: Transfer In
rows.text: A unit transfers in from another formation or off-world. Player: add a unit. Operational: your Zone gains +1 Army Strength if currently 4 or less.

rows.title: Front Transfer
rows.text: The focal unit moves to a different area of the conflict. Operational: move your forces to a different Zone.

rows.title: R&R
rows.text: The focal unit rests, recovers and refits. Player: make force changes, recover casualties, repair. Operational: your Zone is raised to Army Strength 3 if currently 3 or less.

rows.title: New Front Opens
rows.text: A new area joins the conflict. Player: play a battle there. Operational: add a Zone, both sides at Army Strength 4, and fight there this turn.

rows.title: Remote Conflict *
rows.text: A linked conflict breaks out in another country, planet or system. Player: play a battle there. Operational: creates a new operational conflict. (Dramatic: reroll if it does not fit.)

rows.result: Miraculous escape (+1 Luck; all carried items lost)
Crippling wound (surgery, or −1 to the higher of Speed or Toughness)

rows.label: First character to inflict a casualty
Each kill (not in the book; portal option)
Each squad, crew or individual that took part
Individual, battle won (2D6, keep the higher)

rows.name: Kill Target
rows.text: Randomly select an enemy figure on the table; completed when it is killed.

rows.name: Score Kills
rows.text: Randomly select one of your figures; completed when it kills two enemies.

rows.name: Kill Confirmed
rows.text: Mark where the next enemy is killed; completed when one of your figures moves into contact with the marker.

rows.name: Stay Alive
rows.text: Randomly select one of your figures; completed if it survives the next three rounds.

rows.name: Capture
rows.text: At the end of two consecutive rounds, have troops in a target terrain feature with no enemies present.

rows.name: Scout
rows.text: Two target terrain features must both be contacted by any of your figures.

rows.name: Sneak Through
rows.text: A figure must move off the opposing battlefield edge.

rows.name: Engagement
rows.text: 1 VP per Hero, Leader, squad or vehicle destroyed or driven off; highest total wins. With unequal unit counts, the smaller army picks units worth 2 VP until values match.

rows.name: Vital Ground
rows.text: Terrain features partly within 4" of the table centre: hold the majority at game end with the enemy holding none.

rows.name: Hold the Field
rows.text: Three markers evenly spaced on the centre line; secure with troops within 2" and no enemy within 2" at round end. Hold 2 at the end to win.

rows.name: Recon in Force
rows.text: Have more infantry units (2+ figures left) in the enemy deployment area than they have in yours at game end.

rows.name: Break Point
rows.text: Destroy or drive off 50% of enemy units; the game ends at that round end. Both at once, or the Clock runs out, is a draw.

rows.name: Search and Retrieve
rows.text: Markers in the six features nearest the centre line; the first infantry unit to enter removes one and rolls D6, finding the target on a roll ≤ markers removed. Holder at the end wins.

rows.name: Poor support
rows.text: All support availability numbers +1 (6+ becomes 7+).

rows.name: Limited support
rows.text: Failing to call support raises its availability by 1.

rows.name: Jammed transmissions
rows.text: All communications require a test (5P:T p.120).

rows.name: Chance encounter
rows.text: All troops deployed on the table begin Confused (p.121).

rows.name: Dangerous terrain
rows.text: A random feature in each table quarter is Dangerous (p.122).

rows.name: Limited ammo
rows.text: Gun crew and vehicle weapons use Dwindling Ammo (p.123).

rows.name: Limited visibility
rows.text: Limited Visibility applies (p.123). Roll 1D6: 1 Dawn, 6 Dusk.

rows.name: Weapons testing
rows.text: Each player picks one weapon: a prototype with +1 Damage, using the Unreliable/Prototype rule (p.131).

rows.name: Unstable terrain
rows.text: The first time each feature is entered, roll 1D6; on a 1 it collapses and is removed.

rows.name: Fight to the bitter end
rows.text: All troops +1 to effective Morale.

rows.name: Snap decisions
rows.text: No Overwatch actions this battle.

rows.name: Uncertain ground
rows.text: No unit may Dash / Move Out.

rows.name: Rivalry
rows.text: Each player picks one squad: Fearless, does not test Morale.

rows.name: Combat specialist
rows.text: Each player picks one figure: X2 attacks in close assault (p.36).

rows.name: Storm tactics
rows.text: All close assault attacks +1 to the Hit die.

rows.name: Hesitation
rows.text: First turn: activate only 1 unit per phase.

rows.name: Lack of fire control
rows.text: Units cannot split fire; figures that cannot see the primary target cannot fire.

rows.name: Heroic battle
rows.text: Each player picks one figure: +1 KP.

rows.name: Frantic battle
rows.text: All units +1 Reaction.

rows.name: Tank hunt
rows.text: Natural 6 to hit a vehicle: +1 Damage.

rows.name: Unexpectedly vital mission
rows.text: Each VP awarded: roll 1D6, on a 6 award 1 more VP.

rows.name: Lengthy battle
rows.text: Add 1 round to the game length.

rows.name: Uncertain battle length
rows.text: After the last round roll 1D6: 1–4 ends, 5–6 another round; repeat.

rows.name: Delayed
rows.text: Each player picks a random unit to start off-table; it arrives from its edge when activated in Round 3.

rows.name: Immediate reserve
rows.text: Up to half your units may start off-table and arrive from your edge when activated in Round 2.

rows.name: Positional warfare
rows.text: Each player may place barricades or trenches giving Cover to two infantry squads or gun crews.

rows.name: Shelling terrain
rows.text: Each player may replace one terrain feature with craters or ruins.

rows.name: Ammo supply
rows.text: One squad or gun crew may reroll up to 3 missed shooting hit rolls this game.

rows.name: Rookies
rows.text: Each player randomly picks one unit: −1 Reaction.

rows.name: Cover the rear
rows.text: Each player picks one unit that does not take part.

rows.name: Junior leadership
rows.text: Each player picks one squad: its leader +1 KP.

rows.name: Static warfare
rows.text: The first unit each player activates in a round cannot move.

rows.name: Fight to the end
rows.text: No Skulk or Fall Back actions.

rows.name: Hero battle
rows.text: All squad leaders and individuals +1 KP.

rows.name: Brave
rows.text: +1 to all Morale tests; cumulative with Motivator.

rows.name: Tank hunters
rows.text: One figure per activation may take a Tank Killer shot: one shot, +1 to Hit and damage. Declare before firing.

rows.name: Keen shots
rows.text: +6" range with rifles; one rifle shot per activation may add +1 to Hit after rolling.

rows.name: Die-hards
rows.text: When deploying, one figure other than the sergeant gets +1 KP.

rows.name: Fire drill
rows.text: If the squad does not move, add Combat Skill to Hit when firing on Overwatch.

rows.name: Brawlers
rows.text: In close assault, reroll any 1 on the attack dice once.

rows.name: Fearless
rows.text: The squad becomes Fearless (p.46).

rows.name: Bombers
rows.text: Two figures per activation may throw grenades; thrown range +2"; +1 damage when assaulting vehicles with grenades.

rows.name: Guerillas
rows.text: May fire pistols and rifles while Dashing; hits only on a natural 6.

rows.name: Quick
rows.text: +4" when Dashing instead of +2".

rows.name: Rugged
rows.text: +1 KP.

rows.name: Parry
rows.text: Once per close assault, force one incoming assault on the sergeant to be rerolled.

rows.name: Motivator
rows.text: +1 to all squad Morale tests; cumulative with Brave.

rows.name: Fighter
rows.text: Two attacks in close assault.

rows.name: Survivor
rows.text: When hit from any source, roll 1D6; on 5–6 the hit has no effect.

rows.name: Tactics
rows.text: The squad counts as +1 Reactions.

rows.name: Experienced Eye
rows.text: +1 to Hit with all ranged attacks.

rows.name: Alert
rows.text: Observation rolls spot at +3".

rows.name: Gun-slinging
rows.text: May use two pistols at once, both at the same target unit.

rows.name: Quick feet
rows.text: Dash bonus equals normal Speed instead of +2".

rows.name: Deadly accuracy
rows.text: Reroll any 1 on the initial dice of any attack.

rows.name: Lucky
rows.text: 6+ Saving Throw.

rows.name: Skilled leader
rows.text: Leader only: Morale bonus applies within 9".

rows.name: Expert fighter
rows.text: One additional close combat attack.

rows.name: Defend the guns
rows.text: Defending a close assault, each figure strikes twice when rolling to hit.

rows.name: Fortified positions
rows.text: 6+ Saving Throw against all Hits.

rows.name: Deploy hidden
rows.text: Hidden until it first fires; must be spotted with an Observation roll.

rows.name: Gun drill
rows.text: May reroll a single Hit die.

rows.name: Redeployment
rows.text: Moves 2" per crew figure, to a maximum of 6".

rows.name: Target selection
rows.text: May ignore target selection rules and fire at any squad or vehicle in sight.

rows.name: Gunnery
rows.text: Main weapon: natural 6s on the Hit dice allow one additional shot at the same target.

rows.name: Command
rows.text: +1 Reaction.

rows.name: Driving
rows.text: One additional turn per move.

rows.name: Damage control
rows.text: If immobilized, roll 1D6 on activation; 5–6 regains mobility.

rows.name: Improvised armor
rows.text: +1 KP.

rows.name: Defensive measures
rows.text: Close assault attacks on the vehicle are −1 to Hit.

rows.label: Regions per point of total Cohesion (book: at least 1; example 1.5)
Player Battle Points earned per army per turn
Player Battle Points saved per army
Defense Quality of a Defensible region
Army Strength cap in Inhospitable regions
XP premium for a second veteran skill (FCG)

rows.note: Portal tier (book: mid-battle call of a paid asset)

rows.label: Base figure (Speed 4, Reaction 1, Combat +0, Toughness 3, KP 1)
Per step of armor save (6+ = 1 step)
